7115fa3bf3.q: How does NetApp use AI in healthcare and what infrastructure challenges do data scientists face?
7115fa3bf3.a: NetApp enables the right infrastructure to make the job of data scientists easier by providing data management solutions. Deep learning in healthcare requires a lot of labeled data to train models. However, data scientists spend 75 to 90 percent of their time on data preparation, data cleansing, normalization, data movement, and data mining rather than actual data science work. This is often caused by not having the right infrastructure, such as data silos. NetApp works as one leg of a three-legged infrastructure stool alongside compute from NVIDIA and fast networking like 100 gigabit per second networking to solve these challenges.

c739af46f7.q: What is the accuracy level of commercial-grade thermal detection systems for measuring human body temperature?
c739af46f7.a: Most commercial-grade thermal detection systems are accurate within 0.4 degrees Fahrenheit or Celsius, providing accuracy consistently less than half a degree. This level of precision allows systems to clearly identify if someone has an elevated temperature relevant to health monitoring, such as detecting fever symptoms associated with COVID-19.
